# FruitZen

> FruitZen is a fresh-juice and wellness bar in Kukatpally, Hyderabad, India. Fresh juices (₹50–₹120), cold-pressed juices with no added sugar (₹60–₹150), smoothies, shakes, cold coffees, mojitos, fruit bowls, waffles and momos, made to order from fruit sourced every morning.

- Address: Shop No 1, H.No 4-42-950, near HP Petrol Pump, Ramarao Nagar Colony, Paparayadu Nagar, Kukatpally, Hyderabad, Telangana 500072
- Hours: Monday–Sunday, 9:00–23:00
- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 91117 36777
- Services: dine-in, takeaway, delivery via Swiggy and Zomato; free Wi-Fi
- Menu with prices: https://fruitzen.in/menu
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/fruitzen.in/
